sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Feels empty. Sunken eyes; pupils dilated;
weak sight. Vertigo very persistent.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Constant hunger. Poor digestion. Loses
flesh. Vomiting at night.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Pain in stomach and abdomen; worse
about umbilicus [Cocc.; Nux m.; Plumb.] ; ineffectual
urging. Itching at anus. Dragging in vaginal region,
as if hernia would protrude. Swelling resembling um-
bilical hernia.

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Oppressed, wdth sighing. Pain between
shoulders; even clothing is oppressive.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Itching m palms. Sensation as if pimples
would break out. Jaundiced complexion.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Pain around shoulders, as if heavy
load had been carried. Pain in all finger-joints. Tear-
ing in knee-joint. Convulsive movements.
